posts.cooked: I have used the “better fishing” addon (that is on curseforge) for some time now, but I got some mixed information that people said they got permabanned by using it. Is this true or false?

posts.name: Leounity
posts.cooked:
Better Fishing works within the one keystroke → one action ruleset. It doesn’t do any automatic fishing for you.

As a general rule, add-ons from Curse Forge are fine to use. If you have to download or use any other external programs to get those add-ons to work, that is when it can become questionable.

posts.name: Scrinshee
posts.cooked:
Looking at the mod, assuming you’re following the basic functionality listed, you should be fine.

How to Fish after binding the key:

  1. Press the key to start fishing
  2. Wait for the fishing sound
  3. Press the key to interact with the bobber
  4. Repeat

While I am not an expert on the subject, my bet is that people who have used this as a base for a functionality that isn’t allowed. As long as you are pressing one key to cast and one key to reel, you should be fine.

posts.name: Trixie
posts.cooked:
Scrinshee:

pressing one key to cast and one key to reel,

You also have to mouse over the bobber. Programs that allow you to reel in when the bobber bounces without the mouse pointer on the bobber would be circumventing the process.

The process should be:

  1. Press the key to start fishing
  2. Mouse over the bobber until you see the little fishhook
  3. Wait for fishing sound
  4. Press the key to interact with the bobber
  5. Repeat

If the addon is doing step 2 for you, that’s automation and you are at risk of an account action.

posts.name: No1UKnow
posts.cooked:
Yup. Since at least 11.x, your fishing cast will always land someplace where the bobber is your default “interact” target as long as you don’t change facing much.

You can get two-button fishing with a keybind for casting and your chosen “interact” keybind, no addons or macros needed. You can get one-button fishing with a macro castsequence. An addon can legitimately do anything a macro can. So the addon is not the ban risk.

It’s like the getaway driver in a bank robbery claiming to have been arrested for a Sunday afternoon drive.

This is 100% ok and is built into the game on purpose for people who can’t easily click on small things, for NPCs when blocked by mounts, etc.

It is how I fish. I have been fishing using the WoW interact function for years.

You just have to be close enough to the target and facing it basically.
